label: Basic
description: Basic carousel. Best for the minimal setup: 5 square photos one per view, with dots and arrows.

label: Vertical
description: Vertical carousel orientation. Best for cards stacked in a fixed-height column that scrolls up and down, the next one peeking, with arrows.

label: Multiple Items
description: Carousel with multiple items visible. Best for a row holding 3 square photos in view, aligned to the start, stepping one at a time.

label: Responsive Basis
description: Carousel with a width-aware count. Best for portrait photos whose count in view follows the window: 1 on a phone, 2 on a wide phone or tablet.

label: Autoplay
description: Carousel with autoplay. Best for square photos that advance by themselves every 2 seconds, stopped for good by a touch and kept still with Reduce Motion.

label: Centered Alignment
description: Carousel with centered slide alignment. Best for a looping row of 16:9 slides, the shown one centred so both neighbours peek in at the edges.

label: Custom Spacing
description: Carousel with custom spacing. Best for a pair of square photos in view with the slide gutter cut to 4 points.

label: Image Overlays
description: Carousel with images and overlays. Best for wide 16:9 slides with a title and caption set on a dark bottom fade.

label: Thumbnail Strip
description: Carousel with thumbnail navigation. Best for a main slide above a free-scrolling strip of 10 thumbnails that outlines the shown one and jumps on a press.

label: Overlay Thumbnails
description: Carousel with overlay thumbnail navigation. Best for thumbnails set over the bottom of a 16:9 slide on a dark fade, the shown one outlined in white.

label: Dots Navigation
description: Carousel with dots navigation and content overlays. Best for square captioned slides with a row of dots under them, the shown dot stretched wider.
